metadata.question: Did the sea surface temperatures in March 2022 at a location 100 km offshore east of Cairns, Australia, show temperature changes greater than 1°C compared to the overall average water temperatures from 2003 to 2014?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: 100 km offshore east of Cairns, Australia (~-16.9°, 146.8° + ~1° east = ~147.8°) - Time periods: March 2022 vs. 2003-2014 average - Collection: MODIS Sea Surface Temperature (MODIS/006/MOD11A1 is land surface temp, need ocean SST) - Better option: NOAA CDR Sea Surface Temperature or MODIS Aqua/Terra SST products - Use: 'NOAA/CDR/OISST/V2_1' (daily, global SST) or 'NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI' 2. Masking strategy: - For SST data, mask invalid pixels (quality flags or NaN values) - Ocean data shouldn't need cloud masking like land imagery 3. Logic to distinguish: - Valid Zero: SST can't be 0°C in tropical waters near Cairns (typically 25-30°C) - If difference calculation yields None/NaN → C3 - If no images found → C1 - If valid pixels = 0 → C2 - If |difference| > 1°C → A, else → B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions // Cairns is approximately at (-16.9°, 145.7°) // 100 km offshore east is roughly +1 degree longitude const point = ee.Geometry.Point([146.8, -16.9]); const march2022Start = '2022-03-01'; const march2022End = '2022-03-31'; const baseline2003Start = '2003-01-01'; const baseline2014End = '2014-12-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition using NOAA OISST const collection = 'NOAA/CDR/OISST/V2_1'; const sstBand = 'sst'; // March 2022 data let march2022Col = ee.ImageCollection(collection) .filterDate(march2022Start, march2022End) .filterBounds(point) .select(sstBand); const march2022Size = march2022Col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`March 2022 Images: ${march2022Size}`); if (march2022Size === 0) { console.log("No SST data for March 2022."); console.log("C1"); return; } // Baseline 2003-2014 data (filter to March only for fair comparison) let baselineCol = ee.ImageCollection(collection) .filterDate(baseline2003Start, baseline2014End) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(3, 3, 'month')) .filterBounds(point) .select(sstBand); const baselineSize = baselineCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Baseline (2003-2014 March) Images: ${baselineSize}`); if (baselineSize === 0) { console.log("No baseline data for 2003-2014 March."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Calculate means const march2022Mean = march2022Col.mean(); const baselineMean = baselineCol.mean(); // Check valid pixels const march2022Stats = march2022Mean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.mean(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: point, scale: 27830, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const baselineStats = baselineMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.mean(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: point, scale: 27830, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const march2022Count = march2022Stats[`${sstBand}_count`]; const march2022Temp = march2022Stats[`${sstBand}_mean`]; const baselineCount = baselineStats[`${sstBand}_count`]; const baselineTemp = baselineStats[`${sstBand}_mean`]; console.log(`March 2022: Count=${march2022Count}, Temp=${march2022Temp !== null ? march2022Temp.toFixed(2) : 'null'}°C`); console.log(`Baseline: Count=${baselineCount}, Temp=${baselineTemp !== null ? baselineTemp.toFixed(2) : 'null'}°C`); // 4. Validation if (march2022Count === 0 || baselineCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (march2022Temp === null || march2022Temp === undefined || baselineTemp === null || baselineTemp === undefined || isNaN(march2022Temp) || isNaN(baselineTemp)) { console.log("Temperature calculation failed."); console.log("C3"); return; } // SST validity check (should be reasonable for tropical waters) if (march2022Temp < -2 || march2022Temp > 50 || baselineTemp < -2 || baselineTemp > 50) { console.log("Temperature values outside valid range."); console.log("C3"); return; } // 5. Calculate difference and answer const tempDifference = Math.abs(march2022Temp - baselineTemp); console.log(`Temperature Difference: ${tempDifference.toFixed(2)}°C`); if (tempDifference > 1.0) { console.log(`Change of ${tempDifference.toFixed(2)}°C exceeds 1°C threshold.`); console.log("A"); } else { console.log(`Change of ${tempDifference.toFixed(2)}°C does not exceed 1°C threshold.`); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
